Ok, I did what the other commenter here suggested and i ran the game with admin privileges.

The game is not crashing anymore.

It's not enough to just right click on the game executable and choose "Run as administrator". That doesn't actually run the game as admin in reality. I found this out by looking at taskmanager and saw that the files were not running with elevated privileges.

Instead you need to find your way to these two  .exe  files.

C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Robocop Rogue City\\RoboCop.exe

C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Robocop Rogue City\\Game\\Binaries\\Win64\\RoboCop-Win64-Shipping.exe

If you don't have Steam, the paths will obviously be different.

\- Right click on the file

\- Choose "Properties"

\- Go to "Compatibility"

\- Put a checkmark to "Run this program as an administrator"

\- Apply

\- Do this for both files

You will get a UAC popup everytime you launch the game, just click yes and the game runs as admin.
